text:
julie: Quick sync — We're aiming to cut API/SDK v27 tonight 22:00 UTC. Who's owning deploy, smoke, and rollback readiness? I can coordinate client comms if owners confirmed.

alex: I'll be primary deploy owner. I can handle k8s rollout and smoke infra checks. ETA 21:50 for deploy prep.

ryan: I'll own SDK compatibility smoke. Main risk: header change in client handshake (X-RW-Client -> X-RW-Client-Id). We need fallback header acceptance for one release. If not, older clients may 401. I'll push a compatibility shim PR in 20 mins.

sam: I'll run the per-route smoke tests and telemetry checks. Plan: run local canary bundle then 10% canary for 30m. Smoke checklist:
- run `make smoke-local`
- verify /v1/generate latency < 200ms p50
- confirm token cost profile unchanged

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollouts/27 at 22:00 UTC. Canary buckets: 10% -> 25% -> 100% (incremental). Automated rollback: enabled.

infra-bot: Canary health: memory and gcs I/O OK on GPU node pool. No alerts in last 1h. :white_check_mark:

alex: Rollback plan: immediate rollback to v26 manifest if error rate > 2% or 5xx > 1% for >5m. I'll have `kubectl rollout undo` command ready and the infra runbook open.

julie: Client comms — I'll post a short note to #platform-users and release_notes. Include: breaking header change (if shim not merged), migration snippet, and SDK patch version. Alex/Ryan/sam please confirm final status by 21:30 UTC so I can publish.

ryan: Shim PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/842. Tests passing, awaiting review from @alex. If merged, it's non-breaking.

alex: LGTM on the shim. @sam start smoke run at 21:55 and ping here with `SMOKE: PASS` or `SMOKE: FAIL`.

sam: Will do. Running now on staging. Quick log:
```
$ make smoke-local
ok  /v1/embeddings ping
ok  /v1/generate latency p50 185ms
warn token cost +3% on sample set
```

sam: SMOKE: PASS (small cost warning noted — opens ticket #INF-982). Can start canary at 22:05.

julie: Thanks. I'll draft comms now. If anything changes, ping @julie and I'll hold the public note. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary moved to 25% at 22:20 UTC. Monitoring.

alex: Canary steady. No error spike. Proceed to 100% at 22:40.

infra-bot: Monitoring metrics stable. No rollback triggered.

sam: Post-deploy quick checks done. All routes green. Closing smoke run.

julie: Posting release note now. PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/311. Tagging customers with opt-in migration steps.

ryan: Verified header shim logs show acceptance from older clients for 3 hours. Marking compat check: PASS.

julie: Great job team — closing thread. If anyone spots regressions, reopen and ping ops.
